comment: The nine historical helper files every KMD transition reuses byte for byte: the kmd168 transition helpers, bounded-child.exe and select-driver.exe. kmdcommon.HIST points at the copy of this set under the kit's WORK directory; historical_manifest() refuses to continue unless this file is the one kmdcommon.HIST_MANIFEST_SHA256 pins and every file in HIST still has the digest recorded here.

provenance.origin: M727 stage manifest of the measured 170 -> 171 promotion; its own SHA256 is historical_stage_manifest_sha256 above, and every frozen attempt records that value as runner.historical_stage_manifest.
provenance.lost: The workspace cleanup of 2026-10-12 deleted that directory. No byte copy of the 171 stage-manifest.json survives, in the workspace, on the lab or in git history, so the kit can no longer read the set through its original manifest.
provenance.recovered: 2026-10-12. The nine files survive byte for byte inside four later frozen attempts: kmd192-deploy001, kmd193-deploy001, kmd196-deploy001, kmd197-deploy001. Each of those attempts recorded runner.historical_stage_manifest = historical_stage_manifest_sha256, lists all nine files with digests, and still matches those digests on disk. All four agree on every digest, and the seven kmd168-transition files tracked in this repository under template/kmd168-transition match them too. The bytes were copied from kmd192-deploy001 with per-file digest verification.
provenance.reason: A tracked manifest plus a set inside the kit's own WORK directory, which the cleanup keeps, makes the historical input durable: nothing the kit needs sits in a closed milestone's scratch tree any more.
